entities.summary: Adalberto Martínez Flores is a Paraguayan Catholic prelate who has served as Archbishop of Asunción since 2022. He has been a bishop since 1997. Flores became the first Paraguayan cardinal in 2022, in a consistory led by Pope Francis.
